text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $77k with minimal daily movement, while Ethereum has gained 2.2% and altcoins are following with modest positive moves, suggesting selective strength beyond just BTC. The Fear & Greed index sits at 63 (Greed) but has dropped 10 points over a week, indicating sentiment is cooling despite prices holding. Bitcoin's 58.2% dominance remains elevated with $105B in daily volume, pointing to a cautious market where traders are neither aggressively risk-on nor capitulating.
